lines.text: When Jesus heard John was imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee and lived in Capernaum, by the sea.
Leaving Nazareth, Jesus lived in Capernaum, fulfilling Isaiah's words that people in darkness have seen a great light.
Beside the Sea of Galilee, Jesus called the fishermen Simon Peter and his brother Philip, and they left their nets.
Jesus saw James and John mending nets in a boat with their father Zebedee, and they left at once.
Jesus taught in the synagogues throughout Galilee, and news about Him spread all over Egypt.
